name: video-script
description: Writes one product video as a complete package: a script told as one argument a listener can follow, the packaging (title, thumbnail, description, chapters, tags) and the shot notes for the builder. Flow-reads the script as heard, fact-checks it, and shows the approver a rough-cut video instead of a document. Use when asked for a video script, the next video in a playlist, a video description, or a handover for the person who builds the video.
